entities.summary: The Diplôme d'études en langue française or DELF for short, is a diploma of French-language abilities for non-native speakers of French administered by France Education International for France's Ministry of Education. It is composed of four independent diplomas corresponding to the first four levels of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages: A1, A2, B1 and B2. Above this level, the "Proficient User" divisions are certified by the DALF.
